news.title: CANBK: Refined Model Will Support An Undervalued Yet Steady Earnings Opportunity
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for Canara Bank steady at ₹158.63, with only marginal tweaks to inputs such as discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E. This has led to no change in the headline price target but a slightly refined valuation model behind it.

news.title: CANBK: Upcoming Results Review Will Support A Slightly Trimmed Yet Bullish Opportunity
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their fair value estimate for Canara Bank from about ₹161.63 to roughly ₹158.63, reflecting slightly softer expectations for revenue growth and valuation multiples, partly offset by a marginally higher projected profit margin. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for January 29, 2026, to review and approve the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the third quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025 (Key Developments).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹5.79 (vs ₹4.65 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹5.79 (up from ₹4.65 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹79.6b (down 43% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹52.5b (up 25% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 66% (up from 30% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 13% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 2.8% growth forecast for the Banks industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 18% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 35% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
